settings.title: Settings
settings.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for the official endpoint; the OPENAI_BASE_URL env var wins over this value.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste a new API key (saved to the OS keychain)
settings.priorityHint: Keys are kept only in the OS keychain, never in plain files; env OPENAI_API_KEY takes priority over the keychain.
settings.saveOk: API key saved to the OS keychain.
settings.cleared: API key removed from the keychain.

tree.title: Library
tree.emptyHint: Create a project and its design tree shows up here.
tree.lockedPage: Generate board candidates and set the anchor in Overview first.
tree.lockedComponent: Finish one page (generate and pick) before component design.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Click "New project" to start.

empty.title: Start from the design system board
empty.desc: Create a project and generate the board first; pages and components will share its style.

detail.title: Details & actions
detail.empty: Pick an item in the gallery to see its brief form, generate button and history.

form.title: New project
form.name: Project name
form.sizeHint: Sides must be multiples of 16, aspect ratio ≤ 3:1, total pixels 0.65M–8.3M.
form.brandBriefPlaceholder: One line on the brand mood, e.g. an ocean-going studio, restrained and professional.

error.multiple: Sides must be multiples of {{multiple}}; {{w}} x {{h}} is not.

board.title: Design system board
board.desc: Palette, type scale, component samples and icon style on one board.
board.brandPlaceholder: e.g. navy blue, brass accent, restrained tool feel
board.colorPlaceholder: e.g. deep navy primary + a touch of brass
board.fontPlaceholder: e.g. Inter / PingFang, modern and neutral
board.referencePlaceholder: Target style or reference image notes
board.anchorHint: Click a candidate in the gallery to set it as the anchor; later generations follow its style.

page.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 48 chars.
page.briefPlaceholder: Describe the information architecture, e.g. left list + center gallery + right details.
page.hint: Compare candidates in the gallery, pick one; the old current moves to history.

component.name: Component name
component.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 48 chars.
component.briefPlaceholder: e.g. primary / secondary / ghost states with hover and disabled.
component.hint: The anchor board is reference 1; page images can be added for context.

error.slugFormat: Slugs allow lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
error.nameFormat: Component names allow lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.

board.anchorDesc: Page and component generations use this image as reference 1.
board.anchorEmpty: No anchor yet: generate candidates, then click one to set the style anchor.

empty.title: No board candidates yet
empty.desc: Fill in the brand and style brief on the right, then generate 1–4 candidates.

board.pickHint: Hover a candidate and click "Set as anchor"; the anchor card carries a brass badge.

flow.candidatesEmpty: No candidates yet: hit generate on the right.

empty.title: No pages yet
empty.desc: Add a page slug and layout brief on the right to start generating.

empty.title: No components yet
empty.desc: Add a component and its type on the right to generate details.

job.etaNote: Real generations take ~30s–3min, up to 3 minutes at most.

dialog.title: Export asset bundle
dialog.dirHint: The desktop build opens the native directory picker; in mock preview just edit the path.
dialog.browseHint: Mock preview: the path above is used
dialog.summary: Exports images for {{pages}} pages and {{components}} components, plus manifest.json and PROMPTS.md.

deleteCandidate.title: Delete board candidate
deleteCandidate.desc: Delete candidate {{id}}? This cannot be undone.

deleteItem.title: Delete
deleteItem.desc: Delete "{{name}}"? Its candidates and history will be removed too.

ANCHOR_REQUIRED.message: No board anchor is set yet.
ANCHOR_REQUIRED.hint: Generate candidates in Overview and pick one as the anchor first.

ANCHOR_LOCKED.message: The anchor board cannot be deleted.
ANCHOR_LOCKED.hint: Set another candidate as anchor before deleting this one.

NOT_FOUND.message: The target does not exist or was removed.

NO_CREDENTIALS.hint: Open Settings and save an API key first.

KEYCHAIN_ACCESS.hint: Unlock / authorize your keychain, or use OPENAI_API_KEY instead.

EXPORT_FAILED.hint: Generate and pick at least one image first.

API_ERROR.hint: Retry later; if it persists check the environment configuration.

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.message: This capability is not wired to the core yet.
NOT_IMPLEMENTED.hint: This is the mock preview; the Tauri bridge lands in a later phase.

lightbox.hint: Esc to close · Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Double-click for 1:1
